Preliminary experiments are carried out in small laboratories in our department, which are well arranged and equipped, so that experimental work can be accomplished within a reasonable time span and under optimal experimental conditions - even when more equipment may not be available on campus. Thus preliminary investigations play an important role as part of laboratory experiments and hence are directly connected to research topics.
In addition to experimental classes, we hold a seminar to prepare students for their final project, which is part of this subject and which is based on experimental classes in which problems from current research in chemistry are raised and studied. Experimental and theoretical training forms the basis for further research involving computer simulations in a Master’s or Ph.D. project.
